text: Annditee -onon ɓee gomɗimɓe-, tuma wonunoɗon seeɗaaɓe Makka, yimɓe ton ɓen no lo'ina on, hiɗon hula nde ayɓe mon wippotoo on. Alla baki on O weerni on Madiina, O semmbiniri on wallugol on e ayɓe mon ka hare badri, O arsiki on immorde e laaɓuɗi; wano konhoyri ndin belajo'o, on yettay neemaaji Alla ɗin, O ɓeydana on, accon yeddugol sakko O teetadɗi e mon o O lepta on.
